ques: Alice wants Apple's latest annual and quarterly reports. Find Apple through EDGAR company search and compare its most recent Form 10-K and Form 10-Q: report each filing's date, period of report and accession number, and which period is longer. Then log in as alice.j@test.com / TestPass123!, add Tesla to her watchlist from Tesla's company page, and report how many companies her watchlist now shows.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: Find Apple through EDGAR company search and open its company page. Report the most recent Form 10-K's filing date, period of report and accession number, and the most recent Form 10-Q's filing date, period of report and accession number, exactly as the filing pages show them, and which period of report is longer. Log in as alice.j@test.com / TestPass123!, find Tesla through company search, add it to Alice's watchlist from Tesla's company page, open My Account and report the watchlist count shown. PASS requires every date, period, accession number and count exactly as the pages show them. FAIL on any wrong value or an empty answer.

ques: An analyst studies artificial-intelligence disclosures. Then open Apple's EDGAR company page, report how many 10-K filings it lists, the newest one's filing date and Apple's CIK, and open that 10-K to report its period of report.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: Search EDGAR full-text search for artificial intelligence limited to Form 10-K and report the total documents plus the top result's company and filing date. Run the same query limited to Form 8-K and report the total. Narrow the 10-K query to filings from 2020-01-01 onward and report how many documents the results table lists. Open Apple's EDGAR company page and report how many 10-K filings it lists, the newest one's filing date and Apple's CIK, then open that 10-K and report its period of report. PASS requires every total, count, date, CIK and period exactly as the pages show them. FAIL on any wrong number or date.

ques: Bob is researching Microsoft. Using EDGAR company search, report Microsoft's CIK, SIC code and description, state of incorporation and filer category. Log in as bob.c@test.com / TestPass123!, add Microsoft to the watchlist from its company page and report the new watchlist total from My Account. PASS requires every field and count exactly as shown. FAIL on any wrong value.

ques: Find Tesla's EDGAR filings. Report the filing date, Item numbers and accession number of its most recent Form 8-K, then the same for the next 8-K on the list, and which items they share. Open the most recent 8-K's detail page and report its period of report, then open its primary document page and report the filename shown. Open the next 8-K's detail page and report its period of report. Report how many Form 4 and how many 10-Q filings Tesla lists; open the newest Form 4 and report its period of report.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: Report the filing date, item numbers and accession number of Tesla's most recent Form 8-K and of the next 8-K on the list, and which items they share. Open the most recent 8-K's detail page and report its period of report, then open its primary document page and report the filename shown. Open the next 8-K's detail page and report its period of report. Report how many Form 4 and how many 10-Q filings Tesla lists and open the newest Form 4 to report its period of report. PASS requires every date, item, accession, filename, period and count exactly as the pages show them. FAIL on any wrong value.

ques: A reporter covers insider trading. In litigation releases, find the release for Mukesh Asudani: report its number, date, the court where the SEC filed, and the acquisition he allegedly traded ahead of. Open the case document linked on his release and report its label. Then find the release for Trevon Brown, Craig Grant and Michael Noble: report its number and Michael Noble's total payment. Finally find the administrative proceeding against Trevon Brown and report its release number and file number.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: In litigation releases, open the release for Mukesh Asudani and report its release number, date, the court named in the case caption, and the acquisition the complaint says he traded ahead of, plus the label of the case document linked on the page and that the document opens. Open the release for Trevon Brown, Craig Grant and Michael Noble and report its number and Michael Noble's total payment exactly as the release text states it. Find the administrative proceeding row against Trevon Brown and report its release number and file number. PASS requires every value exactly as shown. FAIL on any wrong release number, amount or court.

ques: In administrative proceedings, open the settled orders against Quillan Black and the other individuals who ran unregistered brokers for security-based swaps. Report the date, how many file numbers the page lists, and the civil penalties for Quillan Black and Tyler MacKechnie. Report how many order PDFs are linked and the label of the first. Then log in as bob.c@test.com / TestPass123! and submit a TCR tip about an unregistered broker, describing what you learned, and report the reference number.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: In administrative proceedings, open the settled-orders detail page for Quillan Black and the other unregistered brokers and report the date, the number of file numbers the page lists, and the civil penalty amounts for Quillan Black and for Tyler MacKechnie exactly as the text states them. Report how many order PDFs are linked under Resources and the label of the first. Log in as bob.c@test.com / TestPass123!, submit a TCR tip about an unregistered broker with a description of at least 30 characters, and report the TCR reference number from the confirmation page. PASS requires both penalties, the PDF count and label, and a well-formed reference number exactly as shown. FAIL on any wrong penalty or an invented reference.

ques: A stranger cold-called Maria pitching Happy City Holdings stock. Check the SEC's trading suspensions for that company and report the suspension date and release number. Open the investor alert about cold callers and report two of the red flags its text lists. Open the FAST Answer on pump-and-dump schemes and report what it says fraudsters do after pumping the price. File an investor complaint as Maria Lopez with the email maria.lopez@example.com, choosing a problem type, naming the firm, and describing the call, and report the complaint reference number from the confirmation page. PASS requires the suspension facts, two verbatim red flags, the pump-and-dump fact and a well-formed reference. FAIL on any wrong date or invented reference.

Report the release number, date, what the funds' investments included, and the amount of the forfeited SpaceX investment. Search press releases for Meyer and report the result count the page shows. Open the litigation release for Owen E.H. Meyer and report its number and respondents. ques: In the SEC's forms index, look up Form 10-K: report its description, SEC number and last-updated date. Then look up Form 8-K and Form 1-A and report each one's SEC number and last-updated date, and for Form 1-A the statute it falls under. Filter the index to forms filed by Public Companies and report how many forms remain; then filter by the Securities Act of 1933 instead and report that count. Open the Form 10-K PDF and confirm the mirror serves it.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: In the forms index, search for Form 10-K and report its description, SEC number and last-updated date exactly as the row shows them. Do the same SEC number and last-updated lookup for Form 8-K and Form 1-A, and report the statute shown for Form 1-A. Apply the filed-by Public Companies filter and report the form count the page shows; apply the Securities Act of 1933 statute filter instead and report that count. Open the Form 10-K PDF link and report whether the mirror serves it. PASS requires every field and both counts exactly as shown. FAIL on any wrong SEC number or count.

ques: Use the FAST Answers search box for each lookup. Search '10-K' and report what a Form 10-K is, the filing window for annual reports, and the answer's origin tag. Search 'best execution' and report what brokers must legally seek for customers' orders. Search 'Section 31' and report what the SEC fee is based on. Search 'Ponzi' and report what organizers often promise. Search 'proxy' and report the modified date on the Proxy Statement answer. Report every origin tag you see.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: Using the FAST Answers search box, look up the 10-K, best execution, Section 31, Ponzi and proxy answers one by one. Report the Form 10-K filing window, the brokers' legal obligation, what the Section 31 fee is based on, what Ponzi organizers often promise, and the Proxy Statement answer's modified date, plus the captured-or-fixture origin tag shown on each answer page. PASS requires every fact and origin tag exactly as the pages show them. FAIL on any wrong requirement or date.

FAIL on any wrong value.
